method: Fourth environmental pass. Georgian micro-zone climate, topography and soil facts come from official PDO specifications. Matrix modifiers are conservative derived simulation values, not published measurements.

climateMechanisms: Caucasus Range branches influence local airflow and shelter

soils.name: Magraani micro-zone soil mosaic
soils.note: PDO specification treats local soil variation as part of the delimited micro-zone; full pedological subunit table remains a field-extraction target rather than being generalized.

topography.setting: Caucasus Range slopes and river gorges around Machareuli, Babaneuristskali and Magraanistskali

climate.snowCover: typically mid-December into the second half of March in the specification
climate.airflow: eastern and western winds prevail along the Rioni valley; mountain-valley airflow intensifies in some micro-areas

soils.name: humus-carbonate clay
soils.distribution: Khvanchkara, Sadmeli, Pirveli Tola, Chkvishi and related villages in the PDO soil table

soils.name: rocky humus-carbonate clay
soils.distribution: Kvatskhuti, Saketsia, Bugeuli, Abanoeti, Gori and related sectors

soils.name: humus soil
soils.distribution: Tsesi, Bostana, Chorjo, Baji and Ina sectors

soils.name: deluvial-proluvial light clay
soils.distribution: Bugeuli, Khimshi, Dzirageuli and Gori sectors

topography.setting: southern Lechkhumi and northern Racha slopes surrounding the river valley
